verdict.rationale: Finix's own docs describe a public API that covers seller onboarding, payouts, payout links and disputes. They also document separate Sandbox and Live API credentials, so a user or agent can drive the product programmatically rather than through the Dashboard. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and evidence of a full endpoint reference in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Finix provides separate Sandbox and Live accounts, along with the corresponding API credentials to access the Finix API.
Use Finix's APIs to build your own custom onboarding experience for your sellers.
You can manage how sellers get paid out using the Finix Dashboard or our API.
Monitor and act on Disputes through the Finix Dashboard or API.
Learn how to create payout links on the Finix Dashboard and via API
